summary: End-to-end verification of centralized RAB approval workflow (Coordinator -> SPV -> Manager -> Sekretaris) on both backend and frontend. Backend: expanded /app/backend/tests/test_rab_submissions.py with 7 new workflow tests (TestRabActionWorkflow) covering full happy path, wrong-role 403, revision at every stage, invalid action value, 404 on missing submission. All 10 pytest tests PASS. Frontend (Playwright on public URL): seeded 3 fresh RAB submissions and drove the full chain via the role selector and RabSubmissionDetailPage. Status transitioned MENUNGGU KOORDINATOR -> MENUNGGU SPV -> MENUNGGU MANAGER -> MENUNGGU PEMESANAN -> TIKET DAN HOTEL DIKONFIRMASI. Buttons approve-rab-button, revise-rab-button, component-revision-note-{i}, mark-ticket-hotel-booked-button all render for the correct role only; Sekretaris sees only booked button, others see approve+revise. Revision writes PERLU REVISI PIC and persists component_notes as expected. PIC Accounting on a MENUNGGU stage sees details+proofs but no action buttons (correctly view-only).

integration_issues.flow: Sekretaris Divisi entry point to fully-approved RAB
integration_issues.issue: InboxPage.js does not fetch /api/rab-submissions and shows no link to /rab-submissions/{id}. After a RAB reaches status MENUNGGU PEMESANAN, Sekretaris has NO way in the UI to discover or open it - they must know the URL. The 'Perlu dipesankan' panel only lists trip-based bookings (getTrips filtered by MENUNGGU PEMESANAN), not central rab_submissions. Verified: Secretary Inbox content contains zero '/rab-submissions/' links and does not mention seeded RAB titles.

ApprovalsPage.js (central-rab-queue) renders ALL rab_submissions regardless of status. As Koordinator we observed rows with status MENUNGGU MANAGER, PERLU REVISI PIC, and TIKET DAN HOTEL DIKONFIRMASI in the same queue - reviewer sees items they cannot act on. Should filter submissions by current role's expected status (MENUNGGU KOORDINATOR for Koordinator, etc.) and/or hide fully-approved and revised submissions.

integration_issues.flow: Sekretaris Divisi cannot list RAB submissions from Approvals
integration_issues.issue: ApprovalsPage guards on role in ['Koordinator','SPV','Manager'] and returns AccessDenied for Sekretaris. Since Inbox also does not surface centralized RAB submissions, Sekretaris has no listing entry point for RABs at status MENUNGGU PEMESANAN.

issues: Role state does not survive full page reloads (on direct URL open, role resets to 'PIC Accounting'). Persist to localStorage or query param so that shareable deep links to /rab-submissions/{id} keep the reviewer role.

action_items: Add central rab_submissions surfacing to Sekretaris Divisi's InboxPage (fetch getRabSubmissions and list items with status === 'MENUNGGU PEMESANAN', linking to /rab-submissions/{id}).
Filter ApprovalsPage's central-rab-queue by the current role's expected status (or at minimum exclude terminal statuses TIKET DAN HOTEL DIKONFIRMASI and PERLU REVISI PIC).
Consider allowing Sekretaris Divisi on ApprovalsPage limited to MENUNGGU PEMESANAN entries (or provide equivalent listing on Inbox).
Persist the selected role (localStorage) so direct navigation to /rab-submissions/{id} preserves reviewer role.
Consider RABSubmissionCreate stricter validation: title min_length, items min_length=1, each item schema (proof_url, label required).
critical_code_review_comments: routers.py action_rab_submission overwrites component_notes on every action; if Koordinator adds notes then SPV approves without notes, the previous notes are wiped. Consider merging into a per-role notes structure (e.g. {koordinator: {...}, spv: {...}}) or appending an approval history.
RABSubmissionCreate model uses items: List[dict] with no schema - server accepts arbitrary shapes; add a Pydantic ItemModel with proof_url, label, price, note fields for safety.

action_rab_submission returns the raw stored document (uses find_one), fine, but no audit trail is written - unlike trips/{id}/approval which pushes to approval_history. Recommend adding an approvals[] array to rab_submissions with {role, action, at, notes}.
RabSubmissionDetailPage.js is a single-line JSX return (~150 chars) which hurts readability and code review; also relies on stringly-typed role checks - centralize role constants.
ApprovalsPage & InboxPage duplicate role-guard patterns; consider a RequireRole wrapper component.
Backend has no endpoint GET /api/rab-submissions/{id} - detail page fetches full list and finds locally. Add GET /api/rab-submissions/{submission_id} for efficient detail loads.

flow dict in action_rab_submission does not handle PERLU REVISI PIC state - once revised, submission is stuck at 'PERLU REVISI PIC' with no resubmit endpoint (PIC has no way to push it back to MENUNGGU KOORDINATOR).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for functional workflow; gating gaps documented above

test_credentials: N/A - demo role selector (PIC Accounting / Koordinator / SPV / Manager / Sekretaris Divisi).
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_RAB_* submissions created directly via POST /api/rab-submissions during testing. Some remain in Mongo (rab-* ids); consider a cleanup endpoint or delete via DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend action endpoint /api/rab-submissions/{id}/action is fully working: enforces role-per-stage (403), supports approve/revisi at Koordinator/SPV/Manager and booked at Sekretaris, writes component_notes and status. Frontend RabSubmissionDetailPage correctly gates buttons via canAct (role + status match) and exposes testids: approve-rab-button, revise-rab-button, component-revision-note-{index}, mark-ticket-hotel-booked-button, back-to-rab-list-link, rab-submission-detail-page. Main open gaps for main agent: (1) Sekretaris entry point in InboxPage (currently no path to fully-approved RABs), (2) ApprovalsPage central-rab-queue does not filter by current role's expected status, (3) role persistence across full reloads. All pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_rab_submissions.py should keep passing after fixes.
rca of the issue: The centralized RAB workflow backend is correctly implemented per review request. The 'frontend gating / Inbox / Secretary entry-point gaps' called out in the request are confirmed: (a) InboxPage.js never calls getRabSubmissions, so Sekretaris cannot see rab_submissions with status MENUNGGU PEMESANAN in the UI; (b) ApprovalsPage.js central-rab-queue lists submissions with no status filter, causing reviewers to see out-of-scope items; (c) ApprovalsPage denies access to Sekretaris Divisi. Reproduction: seed a submission, drive it through Koordinator/SPV/Manager approvals, then switch role to Sekretaris Divisi and open /inbox - the RAB is invisible. Mitigation: in InboxPage.js add a submissions state fetched via getRabSubmissions and render 'Perlu dipesankan (RAB)' panel with links to /rab-submissions/{id} for status === 'MENUNGGU PEMESANAN'; in ApprovalsPage.js filter submissions by role-expected status (MENUNGGU KOORDINATOR/SPV/MANAGER).
